aboutBody.message: TLDR Nano summarizes the page or text selection in your active tab using your browser's built-in Summarizer API (Chrome 127+). The model runs entirely on your device. Page text is processed in the side panel and discarded - no server, no account, no API key, no network egress.

aboutPrivacy.message: Keep your reading on your device

aboutPrivacyBody.message: Does not handle user data. Defaults and recent-summaries history live in browser storage on your machine. The only network call is license verification, gated on Pro license entry - it never fires for free users.

footerDisclaimer.message: Not affiliated with Google or Chrome. Chrome is a trademark of Google LLC.
footerDisclaimer.description: TM disclaimer required per SPEC. Must appear verbatim on every surface footer.

stateIdleTitle.message: Get a TL;DR in one click

stateIdleHint.message: Click Summarize page below. Or highlight text first to focus the summary on that passage alone.

noticeTruncated.message: Page too long, summarized first 24 chunks.

truncatedNotice.message: Long page: summarized the first $1 chunks. Try selecting a section for tighter focus.
truncatedNotice.description: Positional placeholder per tree-tabs fleet lesson. $1 is the chunk count.

downloadHint.message: Chrome will download the Nano model in the background. This happens once. Summarize stays unavailable until it finishes.
